00

A house built on the feeling people leave with.

LEEX is a Saudi luxury entertainment and events house. We design and produce experiences for brands, institutions, and private clients who expect the extraordinary as standard. The identity is minimal by discipline and vibrant by signature: quiet space, sharp type, and a spectrum of light that only appears at the moment it matters.

01

Logo

The wordmark is built entirely from detached strokes. The E's drop their stems to become three floating bars, the L splits its stem from its foot, and the X breaks apart at the crossing: a fragmented, kinetic feel that nods to sound and motion. A subtle forward italic gives the mark its lean, and the X stays the signal letter, carrying the LEEX Spectrum.

02

Color

Neutrals do the heavy lifting; the LEEX Spectrum is the moment of light. Two chosen neutrals carry a faint violet bias so nothing reads as default black or grey. Iris and Aqua are the cool electric sparks, used only for emphasis.

03

Typography

A tight, modern grotesque carries every headline; a monospace utility face handles data, times, and ticketing, giving the system a precise, backstage feel. Two families, one confident voice.

Aa Xx

ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ   abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz   0123456789

Display & Headlines

Unforgettable, by design.

Grotesk, weight 700–800, tight tracking (-2 to -4%). Production face: Neue Haas Grotesk Display or TWK Everett. Free web alternative: Archivo or Inter Tight. Rendered here in the Helvetica family.

Body

Experiences engineered for the individuals and brands who set the standard in the Kingdom and beyond.

Regular weight, 1.5 line height, set to roughly 65 characters per line for comfort. Neutral, quiet, always in service of the message.

Utility / Data

DOORS 21:00 · SEC A · 2026.11.14

Monospace, uppercase, wide tracking. For labels, timestamps, ticket data, and captions. Production face: Söhne Mono. Free alternative: JetBrains Mono.

04

Art direction

The LEEX world is shot the way the events feel: cinematic, low-key, and lit by the Spectrum. Magenta and orange beams cut through haze against deep black. Silhouettes over faces, atmosphere over detail, every frame a moment you almost remember.

06

Voice

LEEX speaks the way it designs a room: confident, spare, and sensory. Short lines. Real detail. No hype for its own sake.

Assured, not loud

Is: "The art of experience."

Isn't: "The BEST events in Saudi!!!"

Sensory, not abstract

Is: "Sound, light, and a room that holds its breath."

Isn't: "Innovative synergy-driven activations."

Precise, not padded

Is: "Doors 21:00. Strictly limited."

Isn't: "The event will be starting at approximately nine."
